page: Microsoft Azure E372ids_v7 is an isolated, memory-optimized instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by x86_64 Intel processors, it delivers 372 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 2832.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.61 GB of RAM per virtual processor. The instance operates without GPU accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, focusing entirely on high-capacity general enterprise compute and memory density.

Storage architecture is a central element of the E372ids_v7 configuration, which incorporates 22677 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage. The platform is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput persistent storage expansion alongside the ephemeral local disk array. Because this instance type is classified as isolated, it occupies the entire physical host, providing full hardware resource containment and eliminating multi-tenant contention.

From an infrastructure and cost perspective, the instance is engineered for scale-up architectures where distributing workloads across smaller nodes introduces undesirable network latency or software licensing penalties. The consolidation of extensive processing cores, nearly three terabytes of memory, and massive local NVMe capacity provides high resource density for scale-up deployments. E372ids_v7 is targeted at large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, large data warehousing, and high-throughput transactional database engines.
description: Microsoft Azure E372ids_v7 is an isolated memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V, tailored for high-demand enterprise workloads requiring substantial memory and parallel compute power. Powered by x86_64 Intel processors, the instance provides 372 dedicated vCPUs alongside 2832.0 GB of system memory, delivering approximately 7.61 GB of RAM per vCPU. To support I/O-intensive operations, the instance bundles 22677 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage. The architecture features hardware isolation without GPU acceleration, dedicating physical host resources to a single tenant to prevent multi-tenant noisy-neighbor interference. From a cost-efficiency perspective, consolidating massive CPU capacity, multi-terabyte memory, and dense local NVMe storage within a single instance eliminates distributed node overhead for monolithic scale-up architectures. Microsoft Azure E372ids_v7 is structured for large in-memory databases, real-time analytics engines, extensive enterprise ERP platforms, and massive transactional data processing pipelines.
